branch_secret.description: The Branch secret if the originating app; from your Branch Settings Dashboard

app_name.description: The name of the app (max 255 characters).

dev_name.description: The main contact developer name (max 255 characters).

dev_email.description: The main contact developer email (max 255 characters).

android_url.description: The url of the Android store, or package name (com.android.myapp). Note that to set a fallback URL for Android instead, you must also set `android_app` to `2`.

ios_url.description: The url of iOS store, or app id (id512451233)

ios_store_country.description: The country code of the app, default to US (max 255 characters).

web_url.description: Backup website if URLs are null.

text_message.description: The text message to use for text-me feature, {{ link }} will be replaced with short link (max 255 characters).

og_app_id.description: Default Open Graph (OG) app id (max 255 characters).

og_title.description: Default OG title to be used with links (max 255 characters).

og_description.description: Default OG description to be used with links (max 255 characters).

og_image_url.description: Default OG image URL to be used with links (max 255 characters).
